patch.explanation: display_name() subscripted `profile["name"]` without checking for an empty payload, so a None profile raised TypeError (and a missing key would raise KeyError), producing the HTTP 500. The fix adds a single guard at the top of the function that returns "anonymous" when the profile is None/empty or has no truthy 'name' value, matching the documented contract and satisfying test_display_name_empty_payload and test_display_name_missing_name. The normal path (`profile["name"].strip()`) is unchanged,
